_meta.title: Backroom Cruising Tracker — independent verification batch 1 of 162
_meta.selection: All proposals with existing auxiliary research, descending number of distinct websites, then country/city/name alphabetical.
_meta.source_policy: Save original + new exact source URLs. Never count generic destination pages, official place-existence pages, site updates, or recent forum replies as current confirmed sexual activity. No new guessed coordinates or visiting hours.
_meta.limitations: Search engine queries were used, not Google's own website UI. Some guide domains did not return place-specific hits. Individual sources vary in quality and date; no firsthand on-site inspection. No records are ready for publication.
